A.session_notes: Bench drops to 3 sets, same 70kg. It was RPE 10 for all 4 sets on both 08-09 and 08-17, and two sessions at 10 with no reps gained means the volume is the problem, not the load. If set 3 comes in at RPE 8 or easier, add a 4th. Cable crunch earns +2.5 (RPE 8 last time, the only exercise on this day that improved). Everything else holds. CHECK THE WRIST CURL: the plan said 60kg, you logged 25kg twice. 25 is set as the target now - if that was a different stack or attachment, log the real number and I will fix it. Last two Day A sessions ran 62-66 min against a 50-min target; the 3-set bench buys some of that back.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Bench Press
exercises.notes: Hold 70. Stop at RPE 9 - do not grind a 4th set unless set 3 felt like RPE 8.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Hold - RPE 9 twice at this load.

exercises.name: Leg Press 45
exercises.notes: Hold - RPE 9 twice. Partial ROM, knee-friendly depth.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Hold. Strict, no torso swing.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.notes: +2.5 - RPE 8 last session at 75. Kneeling, facing the stack.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Curl (superset A)
exercises.notes: Hold 25. Went RPE 8 -> 10 at this load, so no add. Straight into the wrist curl, no rest.

exercises.name: Cable Wrist Curl (superset B)
exercises.notes: Target corrected to the 25 you actually logged twice. 60s rest after the pair.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly (drop set)
exercises.notes: ONE triple drop, no rest between drops: 45 to failure -> 40 to failure -> 35 to failure.

B.session_notes: This day is deliberately backed off because of the back pinch on 08-21. RDL comes down 70 -> 60 and pull-ups to 3 sets. If anything pinches on the first RDL rep, skip RDL entirely and start at the pull-ups - a hinge on an irritated back is the one thing here that can cost you weeks. Seated row rep target drops 12 -> 10 at the same 22.5 (it was RPE 10 on 08-11). Preacher finisher starts at 35 now - you handled 3x10x35 straight on 08-21. Everything else holds. Build the load back on RDL only once a full session passes symptom-free.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: DELOADED from 70 after the 08-21 pinch. Light, slow, flat back. Any pinch = skip this exercise.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip
exercises.notes: 3 sets, not 4. This is where the pinch happened - stop the set the moment anything catches.

exercises.name: Machine Seated Row
exercises.notes: Same 22.5, reps 12 -> 10 to pull effort back to RPE 8-9.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Curl
exercises.notes: Hold - RPE 9 last session.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: Hold. Good for the upper back after the pinch.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.notes: Hold 75. It was RPE 10 here but RPE 8 on Day A at the same load - it is session fatigue, not the weight.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: ONE triple drop, no rest: 35 to failure -> 30 to failure -> 25 to failure.

C.session_notes: Suggested day - Day C has been sitting the longest (last done 08-16). It is also the day with the most room: 08-16 came in at RPE 7 on box squat, lat pulldown and hammer curl, so all three go up 2.5. Cable row up 2.5 as well. Bulgarian split squat holds the weight but the rep target drops 10 -> 8 - it was RPE 10 and it is the highest knee-risk movement in the program. The last Day C ran 81 minutes against a 50-min target: hold the listed rests, do not stretch them.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
exercises.notes: Hold - RPE 9 last session.

exercises.name: Box Squat
exercises.notes: +2.5 - RPE 7 at 52.5. High box, controlled depth, knee-safe.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Hold 10kg, reps 10 -> 8. Was RPE 10 - back off the effort, not the load. Stop on any knee pain.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: +2.5 - RPE 7 at 40, the clearest add on this day.

exercises.name: Lying Incline Dumbbell Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: ONE triple drop, no rest: 10 -> 7.5 -> 5 per hand. Reps fell 10/5/2 last time, so the drops go lower. Bench 45-60 degrees, upper arms hanging behind you and still.
